name: COD2x
description:
Call of Duty 2 Egg - Built for Calagopus panel, but should work with Pelican & Pterodactyl.
Need a legitimate CoD2 install to copy iwd files from /main/ folder into server.
author: henwoodenator@gmail.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/bash
#
##---------------------------------------------
## henwoodenator's COD2x install script
##---------------------------------------------
## GAME:        COD2 w/ COD2x mod
## DATE:        Nov 2026
## PLATFORM:    Calagopus Panel
## AUTHOR:      henwoodenator / drPyro / mister_apocalypse
## CONTAINER:   Installer container ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:debian
##              Running container ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/games:mohaa (had the i385 libdc++5 binaries inbuilt)
#
## DESCRIPTION: COD2x Install script for Calagopus Panel. May also work with Pelican / Pterodactyl 
#               but untested. Downloads COD2 server binaries, adds COD2x files.
#
## CREDITS: Me, the CoD2x team, Pelican Panel devs
##---------------------------------------------
#
## Uncomment the below line if you want full verbose console output
#set -x
#
##---------------------------------------------
## INSTALL PREREQUSITES ##
##---------------------------------------------
apt install bzip2
cd /mnt/server
##---------------------------------------------
## DOWNLOAD & APPLY BASE FILES & PATCHES ##
##---------------------------------------------
echo 'Download Server Files'
wget -O cod2linux.tar.bz2 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/Calagopus_Eggs/main/cod2x/cod2-lnxded-1.3-06232006.tar.bz2
echo 'Download CoD2x binaries'
wget -O cod2x.zip https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/Calagopus_Eggs/main/cod2x/CoD2x_1.4.6.8_linux.zip
# Expand downloaded files
tar -xf cod2linux.tar.bz2
mkdir cod2x
unzip cod2x.zip -d cod2x
cp cod2x/libCoD2x.so ./
# Add execute permissions
chmod +x libCoD2x.so
chmod +x cod2_lnxded
# Remove unneeded files
rm -r cod2x cod2linux.tar.bz2 cod2x.zip
# Copy default config
wget -O main/server.cfg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henwoodenator/Calagopus_Eggs/main/cod2x/servercfg-default.cfg
echo 'CoD2x Server install complete. Please ensure to mount game iwd files (from Call of Duty 2/main) to /mnt/cod2'

startup_commands.Default: cp /mnt/cod2/* /home/container/main && LD_PRELOAD=./libCoD2x.so ./cod2_lnxded +set fs_basepath /home/container +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +exec server.cfg +set g_gametype {{GAME_TYPE}} +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set dedicated 2 +map_rotate
startup_commands.Manual Map: cp /mnt/cod2/* /home/container/main && LD_PRELOAD=./libCoD2x.so ./cod2_lnxded +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set g_gametype {{GAME_TYPE}} +set sv_maxclient {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +map {{MAP}} +set dedicated 2 +exec /home/container/server.cfg +map_rotate
